metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to fix a neck hump using no equipment.

A neck hump (aka dowager's hump or buffalo hump) is a rounded hunch at the base of the neck that that builds over time due to continual, forward-leaning posture. 

To fix this unsightly bump, this video will be broken up into an easy to follow step-by-step guide that will focus on lengthening and strengthening postural muscles in the neck and upper back.
 
Watch now and get rid of a neck hump at home!

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:00 Muscle Warm-Up
3:08 Strengthening Exercise 1
4:45 Strengthening Exercise 2
6:57 Stretching Exercise 1
9:51 Stretching Exercise 2
